Order 
The present petition has been filed seeking the following reliefs :-
"(i) To call entire record pertaining to land acquisition for APMDC coal mining in District Singrauli.
(ii) Issue an appropriate writ order or direction in nature of mandamus commanding Respondents No.2 to 4 to grant appropriate compensation to petitioner for his land situated in Village Amarai Khoh, Tehsil Sarai District Singrauli has been acquired and appropriated for coal mining of APMDC i.e. respondent No.4.
(iii) Issue an appropriate writ order or direction in the nature of mandamus commanding Respondents to determine proper compensation and extend all the Rehabilitation and Resettlement benefits in lieu of petitioner's land being acquired for APMDC Coal Mining company (Respondent No.4) in accordance with R & R policy 2018 of APMDC (Annexure P-5) as well as the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 as the case may be.

sentences.text: Therefore, an innocuous prayer is made to direct the respondent No.2 to consider and decide the representation within the stipulated time frame.
Learned counsel appearing for the respondents/State has no objection to the innocuous prayer made by the petitioner.

Under these circumstances, this petition is disposed off directing the respondent No.2 to consider and decide the pending representation filed by the petitioner (if not already decided) within a period of 90 days from the date of receipt of a certified copy of this order and communicate the outcome to the petitioner.
Needless to mention that this Court has not expressed any opinion on the merits of the case.
Accordingly, the petition is disposed off.
